method.description: Individually inspected chronological overview sheet of 12 evenly spaced frames plus denser sheets sampling every fourth frame and final frame. Compared against previously visually inspected exact-hash source. Metadata verified with ffprobe. No realtime playback claimed.

observations: Rocket remains a recognizable face-free object with red nose, cream upper hull, yellow-rimmed blue window, purple lower hull, paired green fins and central orange fin.

Flame visibly changes length and contour while the rocket gently bobs vertically; the two decorative stars shift slightly with the action. This reads as a restrained powered hover rather than a static frame.
Rigid rocket components and their colors stay coherent; flame shape changes are appropriate exhaust motion, not object morphing. No new eyes, mouth or character features appear.
White background, full-object framing and bold illustration style remain stable in sampled frames.
limitations: Sampling cannot guarantee frame-perfect smoothness, absence of every inter-sample artifact or seamless looping.
scope: Exact-MP4 sampled visual reward-video gate only. Does not approve processed painting assets or integration.
